$comment: Example Claude Code managed settings for the machines of people who use yolo-sdlc apps. An admin deploys it as managed-settings.json (Windows: C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json; macOS: /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json; Linux: /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json) or through the Claude admin console. Managed settings can't be overridden by project or user settings, so the guard rails hold even if an app's .claude/settings.json is edited. See docs/SETUP.md, 'Managed settings'. The deny list is a starting point: permission rules match how a command starts, so the session hook (scripts/risk-tier/hook.mjs) still does the main blocking, e.g. --admin anywhere in gh pr merge. The cf rules block every cf command for non-engineers, local ones too: they run the app with pnpm dev and never need cf. Remove this $comment key before deploying.
